correctness.rationale: An all-quantifier proof reduces every convolution value to even/odd quadratic-form level counts and a hyperbolic plane for isotropic sums. The exact fourth moment follows from a checked H^2 character-sum expansion, and the radius average from summing a quadratic character over the second radius, including b=0 and b=a exclusions. The quartic elliptic normalization and singular ratios are separately derived. The standalone exhaustive tests cover 21 exact convolution cases and all 74 tested radius family cases, corroborating but not replacing the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A pair of nonzero quadratic spheres is a natural symmetric step distribution and constant-coefficient Fourier aperture. Its fourth moment controls four-step return probability; the varying curvature gives nontrivial genus-one corrections. The exact q-uniform three-valued first-moment cancellation over every permissible second radius identifies a structural arithmetic law across all odd fields, even ambient dimensions, and both Witt types. This exceeds routine single-parameter enumeration and supplies an interpretable mean energy.
